entries.note: The sender dropped the parcel at a pickup point.

entries.note: The pickup point handed the parcel to DPD.
Collected by the courier; after a pickup-point drop-off it is a hand-over in transit.
Scanned in at a depot on the way.
Scanned in at the depot before delivery.

entries.wording: HORÁRIO DE ENTREGA ENVIADA AO DESTINATÁRIO
entries.note: A message giving the recipient a delivery window, which the comment column shows; it is not a scan.

entries.wording: ENDEREÇO DO DESTINATÁRIO INCOMPLETO OU ILEGÍVEL
entries.note: Not delivered because the address is incomplete or unreadable.
Back at the depot after a failed attempt, not a return to the sender.

Proof of delivery; the comment column names who received the parcel.
